description:
A heavy parchment property deed slides across a massive scarred oak table. In this comprehensive deep-dive into Bram Stoker's masterpiece Dracula, we break down the true forensic mechanism behind the defeat of Count Dracula. Not destroyed by holy relics or blind courage, the vampire is hunted down piece by piece through 12 crucial evidentiary exhibits—from shipping manifests to railway timetables.
